entities.name: Gbega
entities.description: A councilor of Femeref on Jamuraa and member of the Council of Voices, a short-haired, small-faced woman with a sharp, assertive demeanor.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A city on the continent of Jamuraa whose council Gbega sits on.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Jamuraa and Femeref lie.

entities.name: Council of Voices
entities.description: The council of Femeref, which meets in the Great Chamber.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: A Femeref figure who pleads for aid to the Efravan caravan.

entities.name: Awateh
entities.description: A councilor who argues the Efravan tribes pose a danger.

entities.name: Jabras
entities.description: A councilor who argues the Efravan tribes pose a danger.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: The leader who welcomes the Efravan to Femeref.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: Tribes camped outside Femeref's walls, suspected by some of harboring Phyrexian agents.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Feared infiltrators whom councilors suspect among the Efravan.

events.summary: In the Great Chamber, Gbega argues against Niambi's protest and says the Efravan tribes should not be given aid.
events.quote: She argued that the Efravan tribes, currently outside Femeref's walls, should not be given aid

events.summary: Gbega backs Awateh and Jabras, echoing fears that the Efravan might harbor Phyrexian agents.
events.quote: Gbega supported the argument put forth by Awateh and Jabras regarding the potential danger posed by the Efravan tribes.

events.summary: Days later Gbega, Awateh and Jabras see Niambi take Sidar Teshunda in a carriage toward the Efravan mines.
events.quote: Gbega, along with Awateh and Jabras, spied Niambi bringing Sidar Teshunda into a carriage headed for the Efravan mines.

events.summary: The councilors arrive too late; Teshunda has welcomed the Efravan to Femeref despite their protests.
events.quote: Teshunda had made up his mind and had welcomed the Efravan to Femeref, despite the councilors' protestations.

relations.quote: Councilor Gbega is a notable member of the Council of Voices

relations.note: Supported Awateh's argument about the Efravan
relations.quote: Gbega supported the argument put forth by Awateh and Jabras

relations.note: Opposed Niambi's plea for aid to the Efravan caravan
relations.quote: her role in opposing Niambi 's plea for aid to the Efravan caravan
